title: Lab 7 - Faster, modular, safer
description: needs/interruptible, a child pipeline, a CI/CD component with inputs, scanners and protections.
scenario: Cut the XYZ pipeline's critical path, split it, publish a component, add scanners, and close the holes around the pipeline file.
environment_setup:
# A gitlab.com account (free tier is enough) with shared runners enabled on the project,
# git on your machine, and a terminal. Keep Build → Pipelines open in a second tab.
git --version
git remote -v
cleanup: # Nothing to clean: pipelines and jobs are history. Delete the scratch project when the track is over.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Measure and cut
tasks.instructions: Record the pipeline duration. Set default interruptible: true (deploys false), GIT_DEPTH: 1, and needs: so build starts when unit-tests finish rather than after the whole test stage.
tasks.verification: Duration drops; the Needs view shows build starting before lint/integration end.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Child pipeline
tasks.instructions: Move the docs build into docs/.gitlab-ci.yml and trigger it from the parent with strategy: depend and rules: changes on docs/**.
tasks.verification: A docs-only MR shows a downstream pipeline; a code-only MR does not create it.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Component
tasks.instructions: Create project ci-components with templates/node-test/template.yml using spec:inputs (node_version, stage); tag 1.0.0; include it from nodejs-app with @1.0.0.
tasks.verification: Passing an unknown input fails pipeline creation with a message naming it.

tasks.title: Task 4 - Scanners and protections
tasks.instructions: Include Secret-Detection, Dependency-Scanning and Container-Scanning templates (CS_IMAGE = your SHA image); add CODEOWNERS for .gitlab-ci.yml; create a group scan execution policy.
tasks.solution:
include:
  - template: Jobs/Secret-Detection.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Jobs/Dependency-Scanning.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Jobs/Container-Scanning.gitlab-ci.yml
tasks.verification: MR shows the Security scanning widget; an MR touching .gitlab-ci.yml requires the code owner's approval.
